audit.notes: Very straightforward to adapt using any active lifestyle or hobby b-roll (such as bouldering, training, running, or city walking). Starts with one longer clip setting up the curiosity hook, then cuts rapidly on every musical beat to short 0.3-0.5s highlight clips when the punchline appears.
audit.summary: A workout montage opens with the creator stepping back after placing the camera down, displaying a teaser hook, followed by rapid beat-synced cuts of various gym and outdoor running clips revealing an empowering message.
